title: SenseNova releases a preview model that runs shared layers twice
dek: SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview accepts text and images, with Apache 2.0 weights and a repeated decoder block.
lede: SenseNova released SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview on October 30. Its open weights let developers test a decoder that repeats computation using shared parameters.

body.text: The model runs 24 layers twice, producing 56 layer executions from 32 distinct layers. The second pass processes the first pass’s output. Deployment requires its custom implementation; the card points SGLang and vLLM users to specific pull-request versions.

social.voiceover: [matter-of-fact] SenseNova released a model preview that runs twenty-four shared layers twice. [break] It accepts text and images, then produces text. Performance comparisons still await published benchmarks and a technical report.
social.short: SenseNova released Loop-9B-Preview on October 30. Its decoder reuses 24 layers across two passes; the weights carry an Apache 2.0 license.
social.long:
SenseNova released Loop-9B-Preview with shared decoder layers on October 30. The architecture repeats a block instead of storing another copy of its weights.
